description:
I'm an ECE student passionate about AI, signal processing, satellite technology, and innovation. Building SAR-SENSE for NASA Space Apps 2026, under “Dancing with the SARs,” to explore NISAR data and ground deformation analysis.

Looking for curious, dedicated teammates skilled in Python, AI/ML, GIS, remote sensing, data visualization, or research. Beginners with creativity, teamwork, and a willingness to learn are welcome. Let's innovate together!
